in_marathi.name: Moolchand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the roots
in_marathi.long_meaning: Moolchand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Moolchand is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Lord of the roots'. It is a revered name in Hindu mythology, associated with Lord Shiva, who is considered the root of all existence. Moolchand represents the spiritual power within us, the connection to our origins, and the foundation of our being.
